name: Azrikam
overview: Azrikam is a male figure from the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Azel. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, with no additional notes or narrative details provided. This positions him as a minor yet distinct individual within the Benjaminite lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Azrikam means '[my] help arises,' reflecting a Hebrew theophoric or meaningful personal name. There are no additional titles or names attributed to him beyond this proper name.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Azrikam as the son of Azel, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Azrikam's significance lies in his role within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, as noted in 1 Chronicles 8:38. While not prominent in narrative events, his inclusion helps preserve the lineage and heritage of the Benjaminite descendants, which is important for understanding the tribal identity and God's providential preservation of His people.
